messages.subject: error when loading rjags
parts:
Hi all. I recently updated R and rjags. I am getting the error below when I try to load rjags. Has anyone seen this before, and identified a fix? I've also emailed Martyn Plummer directly, but thought I'd check here as well.

> library(R2jags) Loading required package: rjags Error: package or namespace load failed for ‘rjags’: .onLoad failed in loadNamespace() for 'rjags', details: call: inDL(x, as.logical(local), as.logical(now), ...) error: unable to load shared object 'C:/Users/Quresh.Latif/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.3/rjags/libs/x64/rjags.dll': LoadLibrary failure: The specified procedure could not be found. Error: package ‘rjags’ could not be loaded

parts: Shoot. Marc Kery pointed out my mistake that I meant “now” not “not”, and I acknowledged it. I thought that conversation was posted to the list, but I am seeing now that it was not. Sorry for the confusion. After updating JAGS, I no longer have this issue.

Sent: Saturday, June 17, 2023 5:43 AM
To: Quresh Latif <quresh...@birdconservancy.org>; hmecology: Hierarchical Modeling in Ecology <hmec...@googlegroups.com>
Subject: RE: [EXTERNAL]RE: error when loading rjags

 

Hi Quresh,

 

Did you try this solution proposed here:

https://link.edgepilot.com/s/cde5d978/WJloawuPlEeGW6yylSSd4w?u=https://bcss.org.my/software/rjags_workaround.htm

 

if that does not work. I had a quite similar issue on Windows 10 Pro. I reinstalled JAGS and made sure to select the option “install just for me” instead of the default “Install for anyone using this computer”. Founds that recommendation on a forum and that fixed the issue for me.

 

Cheers,

 

Arno
